spans.s: हृत् Adj. Taking away, seizing, attracting, &c., (at the end of compounds only.)

. Divided.
 E. हृ to take, क्त aff.

हृतसर्व्वस्व mfn. (-स्वः-स्वा-स्वं) Robbed or stripped of all, entirely ruined.
 E. हृत, सर्व्वस्व all.

हृताधिकार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
 1. Neglecting one's duty.
 2. Deprived of an
office, turned out.
 3. Barred or deprived of one's right.
 E. हृत,
and अधिकार superintendence.

. Destruction.
 E. हृ to take, क्तिन् aff.; also ह्रिति ।

हृतोत्तर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Left without a reply.
 E. हृत, and उत्तर answer.
हृत्कम्प m. (-म्पः) Tremor of the heart.

हृत्पिण्ड n. (-ण्डं) The heart.
 E. हृत्, and पिण्ड lump of flesh.

हृत्वा Ind. Having taken, seized, accepted, &c.
 E. हृ to take, क्त्वा aff.

हृत्स्थ mfn. (-त्स्थः-त्स्था-त्स्थं) Seated in the heart.
 E. हृत्, स्थ what stays.
